backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor for the Focus Babu backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for user profiles, posts, comments, chat messages, test histories, daily tasks, and backgrounds, with access control enforced via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (FocusTree SVG component, growth animation logic, and timer wiring) to their source files, related components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key details of every component, hook, page, and utility in the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes, plus base border and background body styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Focus Babu PWA, including meta tags, PWA manifest/icon links, and an inline script that bootstraps the dark/light theme before React hydrates.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Focus Babu specifying app name, display mode, theme colors, icon assets at 192×192 and 512×512, and education/productivity categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for same-origin app shell assets and network-first (pass-through) for ICP canister API calls, with offline fallback to index.html for navigation requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for all app pages (dashboard, timer, community, NCERT, PDF viewer, test series, daily target) wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all routes with theme management, service worker registration, and conditional rendering of UI elements like the theme toggle, welcome overlay, install banner, and onboarding modal based on current route and streamer mode.
frontend/src/components/community/ChatPa: Community group chat panel that displays messages with user avatars, supports sending new messages, and allows admins to delete messages, with auto-scroll to the latest message.
frontend/src/components/community/Commen: Renders a comments section for a given post, allowing authenticated users to add comments and admins to delete them, with display of existing comments including author avatars and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/community/ErrorB: A reusable dismissible error alert banner component that displays a destructive-styled alert with an optional dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/community/PostCa: Displays a single community post card with author info, image, caption, like button, and embedded comments section, with admin controls for deleting posts and blocking users.
frontend/src/components/community/PostCo: A form component for creating new community posts, handling image file selection/preview (max 5MB) and caption input with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/dailyTarget/Dail: Renders an individual daily task item with a checkbox for completion toggling, inline text editing, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Provides UI controls for authenticated users to upload a custom dashboard background image (JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 5MB) or reset it to the default, with progress and error/success feedback.
frontend/src/components/FocusBabuLogo.ts: Clickable logo component that navigates to the homepage and hides itself when streamer mode is active, supporting both navbar and centered size variants.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login and logout, clearing the React Query cache on sign-out and displaying appropriate loading/state text.
frontend/src/components/ncert/ChapterLis: Renders a list of NCERT chapters with View and Download buttons for each chapter's PDF, validating URLs before navigation or download.
frontend/src/components/ncert/ClassSecti: Renders a collapsible card for a NCERT class that expands to show subject cards for physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics.
frontend/src/components/ncert/SubjectCar: Renders a collapsible card for a single NCERT subject, displaying its chapters or parts with chapters via ChapterList.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: A multi-step onboarding modal that collects the user's name and exam type (NEET, JEE, SCHOOL, OTHER), then shows a personalized welcome message before auto-dismissing.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Co: UI panel for selecting the timer color via preset swatches or a custom color picker with hex input, syncing state with the parent component.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Du: UI panel with increment/decrement buttons and number inputs for configuring focus (1–120 min) and break (1–60 min) durations.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Fo: Animated SVG tree that visually grows through five stages based on a 0–100 progress value, using interpolated transforms and a glowing drop-shadow effect.
Displays today's completed focus sessions as a row of tree emoji icons, reading the count from local storage and refreshing when a session-completed signal increments.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Me: Displays daily session count and streak metrics polled every 5 seconds from the studyMetrics library.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Mu: Toggle panel for enabling or disabling looping lo-fi background music, persisting the preference to localStorage.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Po: Main Pomodoro timer component that orchestrates the timer UI, session tracking, audio, celebrations, forest mode, and onboarding poll, supporting streamer and study modes.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/Pr: SVG circular progress ring component with configurable size variants (default/streamer) and neon glow effect based on the current timer color.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/So: UI panel for toggling the ticking sound during timer sessions, with a toggle switch and a note about automatic bell sounds on session completion.
frontend/src/components/PomodoroTimer/us: Custom hook managing Pomodoro timer state including focus/break durations, countdown logic, wake lock acquisition, tree progress tracking, and persisted settings via localStorage.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallAppBa: A fixed bottom banner that listens for the browser's beforeinstallprompt event and prompts the user to install the Focus Babu PWA to their home screen.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Top navigation bar component with links to main app routes, a deep focus mode entry point, study room dialog, and streamer mode detection to conditionally hide the navbar.
frontend/src/components/SocialLinks.tsx: Renders Instagram and X (Twitter) social media icon links with size variants for header or footer placement.
frontend/src/components/studyMode/DeepFo: Displays a 3-hour countdown timer with a progress bar and a random motivational quote for a deep focus study session.
frontend/src/components/studyMode/ExitFo: A fixed-position button that calls exitStudyMode from the useStudyMode hook to leave focus mode.
frontend/src/components/studyMode/StudyM: A full-screen overlay modal that instructs the user to prepare their environment (DND, phone focus mode, close tabs) before starting a deep focus session.
frontend/src/components/studyRoom/StudyR: A confirmation dialog that opens a specific Google Meet link in a new tab when the user chooses to join the Focus Babu Study Room.
frontend/src/components/testSeries/ExamS: Renders an active exam session with a countdown timer, question navigation, and answer selection, auto-submitting when time expires or the user confirms submission.
frontend/src/components/testSeries/previ: Renders a multi-section previous year paper exam session with per-section tab navigation, mark-for-review functionality, countdown timer, and auto-submit on timeout.
Displays results for a completed previous year paper, computing score and accuracy from flattened section questions and showing save status alerts alongside a detailed answer review.
frontend/src/components/testSeries/Previ: Displays a catalog of previous year exam papers grouped by JEE Main, NEET, and CUET, with cards that let users start a specific paper.
frontend/src/components/testSeries/TestH: Shows a table of the authenticated user's past test results, handling loading, error, empty, and unauthenticated states with appropriate UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/testSeries/TestR: Displays post-test results including score, accuracy, correct/incorrect counts, save status alerts, and a per-question answer review.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggleButto: Fixed-position button that toggles between dark and light themes using the useTheme hook, displaying a sun or moon icon accordingly.
frontend/src/components/user/AuthProfile: Non-visual React component that auto-fetches and creates a default user profile after login if none exists, using the principal string as the display name.
Renders a user avatar with an optional photo or initials fallback, supporting sm/md/lg size variants.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeMotivatio: Full-screen overlay that briefly displays a random motivational welcome message with a fade-out animation before removing itself from the DOM.
frontend/src/hooks/community/useChat.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching chat messages (polled every 3s) and sending new messages via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/community/useComments: Provides React Query hooks for fetching comments by post ID and adding new comments, invalidating relevant queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/community/useModerati: Provides admin moderation hooks for checking admin status, deleting posts/comments/chat messages, and blocking users via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/community/usePosts.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all posts, creating a new post with an image and caption, and liking a post.
frontend/src/hooks/community/useUserProf: Provides hooks to fetch a user profile by principal string and derive a display name, resolving it via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/dailyTarget/useDailyT: Provides hooks for a multi-task daily to-do list stored in localStorage, including fetching, adding, updating, and deleting tasks keyed by user principal.
frontend/src/hooks/testSeries/useCountdo: Custom hook that manages a countdown timer with start, stop, and reset controls using a setInterval ref.
frontend/src/hooks/testSeries/useTestHis: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the user's test history and saving a new test result via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudio.ts: Custom hook that manages an HTML Audio element for a given source, exposing play, pause, and isPlaying state.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthState.ts: Derives and exposes authentication state (isAuthenticated, principal strings, login status) from the Internet Identity hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardBackgroun: Provides hooks to get, save, and clear the user's dashboard background image via the backend actor, handling missing-background errors gracefully.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags.
A generic React hook that syncs a state value with localStorage, initializing from stored data and persisting updates automatically.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingPoll.ts: Manages onboarding modal state for collecting user name and exam type, persisting selections to localStorage and controlling modal visibility per session.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profiles via the backend actor, including queries for the caller's profile and any user by principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyMode.ts: Manages study mode state by toggling browser fullscreen and tracking active status, handling fullscreen exit events automatically.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: A hook that persists and toggles between light and dark themes using localStorage via useLocalStorageState.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base/component/utility layers, CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, typography, and animated background gradient styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants (site name, tagline, identifier) and helper functions for copyright text and app identifier generation.
frontend/src/lib/color.ts: Utility functions for color manipulation including hex-to-rgba conversion and CSS neon glow/text-shadow string generation for the timer UI.
frontend/src/lib/forestMetrics.ts: Tracks and persists a daily tree count in localStorage with date-keyed entries, auto-resetting on new calendar days.
frontend/src/lib/ncertData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for NCERT Class 11 and 12 chapter metadata including official PDF URLs for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics.
frontend/src/lib/ncertLinks.ts: Provides utilities for validating, encoding, and decoding NCERT PDF URLs, restricting links to the official ncert.nic.in domain.
frontend/src/lib/previousYearPapers/cata: Defines and exports a static catalog array of previous year paper entries for JEE Main (2021–2024), NEET (2021–2024), and CUET (2023–2024) with metadata like id, exam, year, and title.
frontend/src/lib/previousYearPapers/inde: Acts as the main entry point for the previousYearPapers module, registering all paper data objects by ID and exporting utility functions to retrieve a paper by ID or filter catalog entries by exam.
frontend/src/lib/previousYearPapers/pape: Exports placeholder PYPPaperMetadata objects for CUET 2024 and CUET 2023, each with three sections (Languages, Domain Subjects, General Test) containing 10 auto-generated dummy questions each.
Exports the JEE Main 2021 paper metadata with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics sections containing real multiple-choice questions with correct answers.
Exports the JEE Main 2022 paper metadata with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics sections containing real multiple-choice questions with correct answers.
Exports the JEE Main 2023 (All Shifts) paper metadata with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics sections containing real multiple-choice questions, some with solution explanations.
Exports the JEE Main 2024 (All Shifts) paper metadata with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics sections containing real multiple-choice questions with detailed solution explanations.
Exports placeholder NEET 2021 paper metadata with four sections (Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology), each containing 10 auto-generated dummy questions.
Exports placeholder NEET 2022 paper metadata with four sections (Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology), each containing 10 auto-generated dummy questions.
Defines NEET 2023 paper metadata with 40 placeholder questions across Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology sections, each with generic prompts and cycling correct answers.
Defines NEET 2024 paper metadata with real-content questions across Physics, Chemistry, and additional sections, including actual prompts and specific correct answers.
frontend/src/lib/previousYearPapers/type: Defines TypeScript interfaces for previous year paper data structures including PYPQuestion, PYPSection, PYPPaperMetadata, and PYPCatalogEntry.
frontend/src/lib/quotes.ts: Exports a list of motivational study quotes and a helper function to return a random one.
frontend/src/lib/studyMetrics.ts: Manages study session metrics (daily sessions and streak) using localStorage, with functions to increment sessions and retrieve current metrics with streak/day reset logic.
frontend/src/lib/testSeriesData.ts: Provides sample test questions for JEE, NEET, and CUET exams along with utility functions to retrieve questions, duration, and test config based on exam type and category.
frontend/src/lib/userIdentity.ts: Provides utility functions to resolve a display name from a user profile with fallback to email or shortened principal, and to derive initials for avatar display.
frontend/src/lib/welcomeMotivationMessag: Defines a list of motivational welcome messages and exports a function to randomly select one.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Community page displaying a feed of user posts with a post composer, a chat panel, and a login prompt for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/DailyTargetPage.tsx: Daily Target page allowing authenticated users to add, edit, toggle, delete, and reset daily study tasks, with progress tracking and sign-in prompts for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Main landing/dashboard page that renders the Pomodoro timer, site navigation, social links, and background controls, with support for custom authenticated backgrounds, animated floating particles, and a study mode toggle.
frontend/src/pages/NcertPage.tsx: Displays a list of NCERT books for Class 11 and 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Math) using ClassSection components, with a header, footer, and branding links.
frontend/src/pages/NcertPdfViewerPage.ts: Redirect-only page that validates an NCERT PDF URL from search params and navigates to the /pdf-viewer route, or falls back to /ncert if the URL is invalid.
frontend/src/pages/PdfViewerPage.tsx: Full-screen PDF viewer page with a sticky control bar supporting back navigation, download, zoom in/out, and page navigation, rendering the PDF in an iframe with encoded URL validation.
frontend/src/pages/TestSeriesPage.tsx: Test series page managing view states for mock tests and previous year papers (list, exam session, results), handling answer submission, score calculation, and saving results to the backend when authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/TimerPage.tsx: Standalone timer page that renders the PomodoroTimer in streamer/transparent-background mode, persisting those settings via localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, store, retrieve, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), border radii, fonts, box shadows, and accordion keyframe animations, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (version 59) describing the 'Focus Babu' study website's features, architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature history across all implemented sections including Pomodoro timer, community, NCERT, test series, and daily targets.
